content_sections.heading: ASI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1/ CC/ GEN/ 2025/ 3159 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ASI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Must be enrolled with any State Bar Council to practice as an advocate Should be proficient in working on MS Word and other computer applications Must mark attendance in AEBAS (or as per the prescribed method) May be called to attend office on Saturday, Sunday or holidays in case of urgency Desirable: Experience in working in a Government / Autonomous organizations/PSU Experience in dealing with matters pertaining to the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958 and The Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis; confers no right to regular appointment Initially for 1 year, may be extended yearly as per requirement Up to 5% increase in remuneration on satisfactory performance appraised by the Performance Appraisal Board (PAB) Eight (08) days leave during the one-year engagement period Termination by one month's notice on either side Must sign a non-disclosure undertaking as per Annexure-III

content_sections.heading: How Will ASI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by a screening committee Interview of shortlisted applicants (the committee may call) The committee may call shortlisted applicants for interview No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ASI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for ASI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 1 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ASI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 65 years (on the date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A degree in law from a recognized University/National institute; enrolled with any State Bar Council to practise as an advocate; at least 10 years' experience in handling court cases; proficiency in MS Word and other computer applications.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be enrolled with any State Bar Council to practice as an advocate. Should be proficient in working on MS Word and other computer applications. Must mark attendance in AEBAS (or as per the prescribed method). May be called to attend office on Saturday, Sunday or holidays in case of urgency.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by a screening committee. Interview of shortlisted applicants (the committee may call). The committee may call shortlisted applicants for interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis; confers no right to regular appointment. Initially for 1 year, may be extended yearly as per requirement. Up to 5% increase in remuneration on satisfactory performance appraised by the Performance Appraisal Board (PAB).

faq.answer: O/o The Superintending Archaeologist, ASI, Chennai Circle, Chennai.
